newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket - Australia declare at 217 for six v West Indies.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Australia declare at 217 for six v West Indies.

text.p: Australia declared their second innings closed at 217 for six on the fourth day of the first test against West Indies at the Gabba on Monday.
Captain Mark Taylor ended his side's innings with Australia holding a lead of 419 runs.
The declaration came 25 minutes into the third session when Paul Reiffel was run out for 11. Ian Healy was 45 not out.
Mark Waugh top-scored for Australia with 57 while Ian Bishop took 3-49 from 12 overs for West Indies.
